title: Opslet runtime: tombstone markers, deterministic replay & audit telemetry
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Problem: We frequently need to migrate short operational runbooks (opslets) into repeatable, auditable tasks executed by oncall or automation. Current ad-hoc scripts lack consistent tombstone semantics (to mark failed/partial runs), deterministic replay, and unified telemetry, which makes debugging and RCA slow and error-prone.

Goal: Implement an opslet runtime layer that: 1) writes a small, versioned tombstone record for each step (start/success/failure/partial) to the event store; 2) emits deterministic replay tokens so any replay produces the same side-effects guardable by idempotency hooks; 3) surfaces a compact timeline in Console and a replayable trace in the ops audit dashboard. The feature should be behind a feature-flag and require a short security review due to provenance guarantees.
acceptance_criteria: Each opslet execution creates a tombstone entry with fields: run_id, step_id, status (started/success/failure/partial), runtime_version, and hash_of_inputs
Replay API (internal) can re-run an opslet by run_id and only executes steps marked as failure/partial when replay-mode is 'resume', otherwise full rerun is supported
Console picks up tombstone entries and displays a timeline widget with step durations and clickable links to logs/traces
Audit dashboard shows a deterministic trace that includes telemetry for token counts, runtime variant, and idempotency guard outcomes
E2E tests simulate a failed step, trigger replay, and assert that idempotency hooks prevented double-side-effects (e.g., API calls marked with replay-safe token)
tasks: Design: finalize tombstone schema and idempotency hook contract — Confluence doc linked
Runtime: implement tombstone writer and run_id generation in opslet-shim
API: add internal POST /opslet/replay and GET /opslet/runs/:run_id endpoints
Console: timeline widget for opslet runs and quick-replay button (behind FF)
Tests: unit + integration + a small chaos test where a step is killed mid-run
Rollout: feature-flag enable on staging for 48h, smoke tests, then gradual canary to 10%/50%/100% orgs
notes: Implementation must avoid writing PII into tombstones; tombstone should only store input hashes and a pointer to secure logs if needed
Use existing event-store topic ops.tombstones (retention 90d) initially; evaluate long-term storage after 90-day retention observation
Idempotency contract: steps may return a replay_token that the runtime will pass back on replay to let the step short-circuit safely
Security flagged: provenance guarantees mean we must insert a short security review; tagged security_review_required=true
Consider using current runlet-telemetry schema to piggyback new fields to minimize Console work
